question: Which of the following peptides are not produced by the renal system?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Renin" -> "produced by juxtaglomerular cells in kidneys" -> "part of renal system" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Angiotensin I" -> "produced by conversion of angiotensinogen by renin" -> "occurs in bloodstream" -> "not directly produced by renal system" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Erythropoietin" -> "produced by interstitial fibroblasts in kidneys" -> "part of renal system" -> 90%
CHAIN: "1,25DHCC" -> "active form of vitamin D" -> "converted in kidneys" -> "produced by renal system" -> 90%
analysis: The question asks which peptide is not produced by the renal system. Renin is produced by the juxtaglomerular cells in the kidneys, making it a renal product. Erythropoietin is also produced by the kidneys, specifically by interstitial fibroblasts. 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol (1,25DHCC), the active form of vitamin D, is synthesized in the kidneys. Angiotensin I, however, is formed in the bloodstream through the conversion of angiotensinogen by renin, and not directly produced by the renal system itself. Therefore, Angiotensin I is the peptide not produced by the renal system. This aligns with the consensus that Angiotensin I is not a direct renal product.
